enchantments.tooltip: Nearly Finished: This item isn't quite finished, but it's only a step away from completion. Bring it to a Cannith Reforging Station and combine it with melted materials to restore this item to its full potential.

children.tooltip: Quality Strength +3: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +3 Quality bonus to Strength.
Quality Dexterity +3: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +3 Quality bonus to Dexterity.
Quality Intelligence +3: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +3 Quality bonus to Intelligence.

enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Seeker +6: Provides a +6 Insight bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +6 Insight bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Shatter +15: This effect gives a +15 Enhancement bonus to the DC to resist the character's Sunder and Improved Sunder attempts.
Stunning +15: +15 Enhancement bonus to the DC of character's Stunning Blow and Stunning Fist attempts.
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
